finding: We gave Meta’s image AI, Muse Image, the clock task from a common memory test: “Draw a clock. Put in all the numbers and set the time to 10 past 11.” By our count it got all three points on 13 of its 16 clocks; 238 of 315 adults did. When Meta’s chat AI, Muse Spark, marked the same clocks, it often mixed up the hands.
